# JLPT Test Hub — Free JLPT Practice Tests (N5, N4, N3)

Free web app for practicing the Japanese Language Proficiency Test (JLPT) levels N5, N4 and N3. Official-format practice questions with an interactive furigana dictionary, instant explanations, timed real-test simulation, spaced repetition review, and multilingual interface (English / German).

## Free question banks & kanji lists (static HTML)

- [JLPT N5 practice test (all 50 questions with answers)](https://www.jlpttesthub.com/n5/): complete N5 question set + full kanji list, printable
- [JLPT N4 practice test (all 50 questions with answers)](https://www.jlpttesthub.com/n4/): complete N4 question set + full kanji list
- [JLPT N3 practice test (all 55 questions with answers)](https://www.jlpttesthub.com/n3/): complete N3 question set + full kanji list
- [JLPT N5 practice test (German)](https://www.jlpttesthub.com/de/n5/), [N4](https://www.jlpttesthub.com/de/n4/), [N3](https://www.jlpttesthub.com/de/n3/): same sets with German explanations

## App

- [Start a practice test](https://www.jlpttesthub.com/#/n5): JLPT practice tests — choose N5, N4, or N3, Real Test (timed) or Learning Mode (instant feedback)
- [Pro features & pricing](https://www.jlpttesthub.com/#/n5): Pro subscription with unlimited real tests, flashcards (kanji/vocabulary/grammar), weakness analysis and PDF export
